Concern: Report shows CIS Azure and MCSB 100% Compliant despite failed authentication; dashboard also shows NIST percentages.
Recommendation: Use selected checks passed, failed and unknown; disclose coverage, exclusions and calculation; avoid overall compliance conclusions.

Concern: Continuous Watch tooltip says simulated telemetry; surrounding text suggests live monitoring and a measured 30-day improvement.
Recommendation: Separate simulations and illustrative history from actual observations; label source, period and successful collection time.
Review status: Observed tooltip and dashboard; historical data provenance not audited

Concern: Sample preset uses Enterprise Production (Breach Imminent); inspected register/report lacks prominent sandbox labeling.
Recommendation: Label all sample views and reports Demo data - no live assessment; avoid unsupported imminent-breach predictions.
Review status: Observed sample preset, register and report preview

Concern: Harden actions and Immutable session audit trail may overstate actual changes and log integrity.
Recommendation: Separate simulation, acknowledgment, execution and verified remediation; substantiate immutability or rename to session activity log.
Review status: Wording observed; remediation and tamper resistance not tested

Concern: Connection guidance recommends Root Management Group Reader or Global Administrator resource-access elevation.
Recommendation: Default to least privilege at the narrowest required scope; explain and obtain explicit approval for broader access.
Review status: Observed connection guidance; no permissions changed

Concern: Automated report identifies the tool creator as Lead Auditor.
Recommendation: Use Tool author unless an actual human audit occurred; identify whether human review was performed.

Concern: CIS control references, benchmark scores and hardened-baseline branding appear throughout.
Recommendation: Verify control mappings, benchmark version, content provenance and applicable commercial licensing; do not imply certification without evidence.
Review status: Licensing and mapping accuracy not independently verified; no infringement determination

Concern: Account-level anonymous-access allowance can be interpreted as confirmed exposure.
Recommendation: Evaluate container settings and effective access; distinguish guardrail gaps from confirmed anonymous access.
Review status: Finding wording observed; detection implementation not audited

Concern: Missing customer-managed keys may be interpreted as lack of encryption or an unconditional violation.
Recommendation: State that Azure encrypts data at rest by default; assess customer-managed keys against documented organizational requirements.
Review status: Preventive accuracy recommendation based on displayed CMK findings

Concern: No accessible privacy/data-flow notice found in inspected interface; token retention and logging unverified.
Recommendation: Publish actual token processing, transmission, retention and deletion practices; verify browser storage, backend, hosting logs and telemetry.
Review status: Interface reviewed; backend and credential storage not audited

Concern: No accessible Authorized Use or Scope/Limitations notices found in inspected interface.
Recommendation: Add account-owner authorization requirement, selected-control scope, exclusions, limitations, contact and Microsoft/CIS independence notice.
Review status: Not found in inspected interface; not a claim of site-wide absence

Concern: App provides copyable CLI commands and an executable remediation script export.
Recommendation: Review workload impact and target scope; provide backups, proposed changes, staging validation, explicit live-change approval and rollback guidance.
Review status: Commands viewed; script not downloaded or executed; safety implementation unverified

Concern: Reports can contain resource names, subscription identifiers and identity information.
Recommendation: Clearly identify demo versus live data; provide confidential-handling guidance and minimize unnecessary personal identifiers.
Review status: Observed interface and report fields; no downstream disclosure assessment
